# C3.3.6 synthetic sequence

All events, candles, claims, recipients, attestations and policy values are invented
for contract validation. They are not XAUUSD historical data or production policy.
`manifest.json` hashes the exact UTF-8 bytes of `sequence.json`.

One composed chain uses accepted grouping, interpretation, reaction, validation,
PA adapter and lifecycle interfaces. Later operations are explicit lifecycle
boundary fixtures, not proof of a production upstream adapter.
The primary bearish scenario retains a separate bullish countertrend candidate
and conditional alternative throughout.

The private XAUUSD 19–20 October archives are deliberately not included.
